title: On-Call Baton Map & Contextual Responder Hub
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a lightweight, persistent "baton" visualization and accompanying "Responder Hub" surface that reduces context-switching during shift handoffs and incident escalation. The baton map should present a timezone-aware summary of current owners, last actions, and immediate next steps; the Responder Hub is a compact panel surfaced on alerts, timeline items, and the incident drawer that wires to postmortems, runbook snippets, and relevant SLO/cost deltas. Goals: speed up handoffs, reduce duplicate investigation, and make rollouts/alerts continuity explicit across shifts.
acceptance_criteria: Baton card appears on incident timeline and alert header with last actor, timestamp, and time-zone adjusted next shift owner
Responder Hub opens via quick-press (space/enter) and shows: linked postmortem, top-3 runbook steps, recent related alerts, SLO delta sparkline, and estimated cost delta
Primary CTA on baton: Claim / Acknowledge; secondary CTAs: Add note, Link postmortem, Escalate
Accessible: baton and hub navigable by keyboard and screen reader labels included
Prototype validated with 6 oncall engineers showing >= 80% success on handoff task in usability test
design_links: Drive: visual assets and exported flows: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleBatonAssets
comments: 2026-02-12 - Ava Chen: Kickoff with ENG and PM. Agreed success metrics and surface scope: timeline baton + alert header hub. Shared initial wireframes.
2026-02-19 - Mateo Alvarez: Low-fidelity exploration attached. Two approaches: ephemeral toast vs persistent ribbon. Team favors persistent baton for cross-shift visibility.
2026-02-25 - PM (Lina Park): Request to surface SLO impact prominently. Added requirement to show SLO delta and link to evaluator dashboard.

2026-02-28 - ENG (Noah Patel): Raised implementation constraints around cheap DOM updates for high-cardinality incidents. Suggested limiting hub previews to 3 items per section and lazy-load the rest.

2026-03-02 - Usability notes: 6 participants (4 SREs, 2 Platform engineers). Observations: users expected 'claim' to also tag calendar timezone; confusion on cost delta units — we added tooltip and microcopy.
2026-03-04 - Design review: PM approved CTA hierarchy. ENG requested simplified data model for quick previews. Reconciled by making runbook snippets pulled from cached playbook extracts.
2026-03-05 - Mateo Alvarez: Preparing Handoff Spec for ENG (links below). Marking ticket In Review and requesting engineering feasibility spike
decisions: Use a compact 'baton' card pinned to the top of the incident timeline rather than a full-width ribbon to preserve vertical space
Responder Hub opened inline (drawer) from multiple entry points: alert list row, alert detail header, and timeline baton
Limit preview sections to 3 items (runbook steps, related alerts, recent links) with a 'view more' that lazily expands
Show SLO delta as a tiny sparkline + absolute % delta; cost delta shown as estimated hourly token-cost with tooltip explaining confidence
Implement timezone awareness by normalizing timestamps to the current viewer's timezone and exposing 'local shift' label
